title: CD1d remodels the tumor-infiltrating myeloid populations controlling antitumor immunity.
snippet: Myeloid cells play crucial roles in cancer progression, influencing tumor growth, metastasis, and response to immunotherapy. The mechanisms shaping their diverse functions in the tumors remain poorly understood and may offer therapeutic opportunities.
